endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: One drive with its evidence: the level, the five outcomes, the part scores, every checkpoint and every attempt

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Which products your agent can use for a task, ranked from our drives (the MCP tool find_tools_for_task): for each, the closest task in its capability map and what happened when our agent tried it, the agent level, whether our agent got in on its own, where it stopped, the work done, the drive date, origin (with disclosure when the owner paid) and the page. Strong matches first, then the ones our agent did, then level and work done. 120 requests per 10 minutes per IP

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Our levels in the MCP registry's v0.1 format, for catalogs that read a registry (base URL /api/registry): the MCP servers the official registry lists that belong to a product we drove, each with our level under _meta["com.agentdrives/drive"]. Cursor pages as the v0.1 API; also /api/registry/v0.1/servers/{name}/versions and /versions/{version} (or latest)

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Every product in the directory (open data, CC BY 4.0): each one driven by our agent, with its agent level, part scores, drive date and origin (editorial or owner, with disclosure when the owner paid). Sorted by level, then work done, then minutes to the first call

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: A support case: open, waiting (an answer is on its way), answered (with the answer) or closed; a dispute's re-drive. The key of the case's account, or the case_token of a case opened without a key

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Dispute your product's published result (a verified claim on its domain, else 403 claim_not_verified). A case opens; while no dispute re-drive of the product ran in the last 30 days, a confirm re-drive of the agent's path is queued (its result shows on the listing once reviewed). The answer comes in writing

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Ask our support a question (prices, plans, levels, the method, your orders, the API and MCP). When our published pages answer it, the answer comes at once, quoted, with every source's id, text and URL (answered: true). When they don't, a case opens (answered: false, case_id; without a key also a case_token) and the answer comes in writing, in the case's status. Never promised here: a level, a refund or a date we don't control. No key needed: 20 questions an hour per address without one

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Delete your account and its data; every key stops working at once. With a session, one call. With your API key (x-api-key), two: the first answers 202 with a confirm token (and the paid drives not run yet that the deletion cancels and refunds), the same call with {token} within 5 minutes deletes. GET /api/me/delete says beforehand what it cancels and refunds

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: A link to invoices and payment methods

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Switch the Monthly drive for one product between monthly ($29) and yearly ($290); the change is prorated and invoiced at once

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Cancel the Monthly drive (or a subscription from before 10 Oct 2026) for one product (order_id) or all: no further charges; it stops at the end of the paid period. The listing stays

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Withdraw an order that has not been paid

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Unsubscribe (link in every mail)

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Subscribe to the monthly report (double opt-in: a confirmation mail is sent; signed in with the same verified address, it is confirmed at once and the answer says confirmed: true). source=launch: the launch list instead, one email at launch

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Pay an order that waits for payment (status requested): its Stripe Checkout while it is open, else a new one for the same order. A person opens payment.url; an agent's own account pays over HTTP 402 instead (POST /api/orders/{id}/payment)

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: The free checkout test. Test your checkout: Add a code and our agent buys your plan with it. A short private drive of your product's pay step: our agent signs up, buys your plan with the code (or in your checkout's test mode), uses one paid feature, cancels and deletes the account. Free for a product you've proved yours; one you've added but not proved counts with the free checks (429 rate_limited, scan_budget_reached), and its report opens once it's proved. One at a time per domain, its subdoma

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Delete the code or login on your order now

endpoints.name: AgentDrives: make sure AI agents can run your product
endpoints.description: Suggest a product for our agent to drive and list (free, anyone): a signal for our planner, never a promise or a place in the queue.

endpoints.name: Cloud Document AI API
endpoints.description: Extract structured data from PDFs, scans, and document images using OCR and ML. Handles invoices, receipts, forms, contracts, tax documents, IDs, and custom schemas, returning text, tables, entities, fields, and confidence signals.

endpoints.name: Cloud Natural Language API
endpoints.description: Analyze text with Google NLP: sentiment, emotion, named entities, entity salience, content categories, moderation categories, syntax, and all-in-one annotation. Supports multilingual text analytics for documents, reviews, tickets, and articles.

endpoints.name: Cloud Speech-to-Text API
endpoints.description: Convert speech audio to text with Google Speech-to-Text. Supports 125+ languages, short and long audio, streaming-style workflows, speaker diarization, word timestamps, phrase hints, custom classes, profanity filtering, and punctuation.

endpoints.name: Cloud Text-to-Speech API
endpoints.description: Generate natural-sounding speech from text or SSML in 50+ languages and 380+ voices. Supports pitch, speed, effects profiles, MP3/WAV/OGG output, long-form synthesis, and Neural2/Studio voice models for production audio.

endpoints.name: Cloud Translation API
endpoints.description: Translate text and documents across 130+ languages. Supports language detection, romanization, synchronous and batch translation, glossaries for domain terminology, adaptive MT datasets, custom models, and document formatting.

endpoints.name: Cloud Video Intelligence API
endpoints.description: Analyze video content asynchronously with Google Video Intelligence. Detect labels, shots, explicit content, speech, on-screen text, logos, object tracks, scene changes, and searchable metadata for uploaded or cloud-hosted videos.

endpoints.name: Cloud Vision API
endpoints.description: Analyze images with Google Cloud Vision ML. Detect objects, faces, text/OCR, labels, landmarks, logos, safe-search signals, web entities, crop hints, dominant colors, and product-search reference images across image, PDF, and TIFF inputs.

endpoints.name: Clustly
endpoints.description: Tip any X (Twitter) handle in Solana USDC via x402. Registered Clustly users receive directly to their linked Solana wallet; unregistered handles are escrowed in a Privy-custodied placeholder pocket the recipient can claim later via X OAuth.

endpoints.name: England Works Watch
endpoints.description: UK Skilled Worker sponsor-compliance change intelligence for employer, HR and HRIS agents. Use for official GOV.UK source freshness, Home Office/UKVI sponsor reporting, supported sponsor change categories, and one-event or batch impact preflight. Supported vocabulary includes absence, salary, role or occupation-code change, work-location or home-working change, delayed starts, stopping sponsorship or worker departure, organisation changes, TUPE transfers, and mergers/takeovers. The public AI edition supports an interactive single-event preflight. Commercial value is concentrated in metered programmatic execution, 1-25 event batch assessment, and the separate 30-day official-source monitoring report. Deterministic decisions return AFFECTED, NOT_AFFECTED, REVIEW_REQUIRED or INSUFFICIENT_INPUT with evidence and fail closed on stale/changed sources. Not individual visa advice or a Home Office decision. The two paid HTTP compatibility routes execute the same deterministic decision engine as the MCP tools.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up a package on npm or PyPI: latest version, description, license, dependency count, keywords and release date. Use it before adding a dependency, to judge whether a project is maintained and how much it pulls in.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert an amount between currencies using European Central Bank reference rates. Use it for currency conversion, to price something in another currency, or to check the current rate.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check whether a specific package version has known vulnerabilities, across npm and PyPI, using the Open Source Vulnerabilities database. Use it as a supply-chain check: given a package and a version, say whether installing it would bring in a known CVE, and which version fixes it.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Geocode a place name, address or landmark into latitude and longitude, with country and city. Use it to turn a location into coordinates, to locate a place, or to get context for where something is.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: MET Norway forecast for coordinates, with 3-day coverage, temperature, wind and humidity. Licensed CC BY 4.0 / NLOD, cached with attribution. Forecast, not instrument observation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up a CVE in the US National Vulnerability Database: description, CVSS score and severity, affected weakness (CWE) identifiers and reference links. Use it to check whether a vulnerability a scanner reported is real and how severe it is, before deciding what to patch first.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Static code review of a source snippet: security problems, bugs and code smells, each with a severity and a message, plus an overall quality score. Use it to review code before merging, to find hardcoded secrets and unsafe patterns, or to get a second opinion on a diff. Accepts source code in any language.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: WHOIS and RDAP lookup for a domain: is it registered or AVAILABLE for purchase, registrar, creation and expiry dates, and status codes. Use it to check whether a domain name is free before buying it, to find when one expires, or to read ownership and nameserver details.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Trending GitHub repositories for a daily, weekly or monthly window, with stars, primary language and description. Use it to see what developers are shipping right now, to scout new libraries, or to find examples of a technique.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Resolve DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME) for a domain against two independent resolvers (Cloudflare and Google) and report whether their answers agree. Use it for DNS lookup, MX record checks, SPF/DKIM TXT inspection, nameserver discovery, or to debug propagation and mail routing.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Current cryptocurrency price in USD and EUR with 24-hour change, by coin id (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, and any other). Use it to look up what a token costs right now, or to price something in crypto. Returns price, 24h change and data source.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI

endpoints.description: Pick selected top-level object keys; absent keys are omitted.

endpoints.description: Read an RFC 6901 pointer from a JSON value without executing expressions.

endpoints.name: Wealth Agent
endpoints.description: Inspect one publicly reachable website or API and return a machine-readable capability report: the entry points it exposes (endpoints, forms, feeds, MCP tools), the evidence behind every finding, and an explicit list of what could not be determined. Only public responses are read; a 401/403 is recorded as auth_required and never bypassed. Use it to plan an integration, document an undocumented API, or triage a vendor before you build on it.

endpoints.name: Wealth Agent
endpoints.description: Full-surface analysis of a target: a website, an API, a shipped JS bundle, or (as a prepared runbook) a local artifact such as an ELF/PE/.NET/Mach-O binary, an Electron app.asar, an APK or a jar. Returns a capability map where every claim carries its evidence, the entry points found, feature flags and client-side secret shapes (shapes only, never values), and an explicit list of what could not be determined. Read-only: the target is never executed, a 401/403 is recorded as auth_required and neve

endpoints.name: Wealth Agent
endpoints.description: Return the line-level diff between two texts as added/removed/unified hunks with counts. Use it to review a patch, compare two API responses, or decide whether two documents actually differ before spending tokens on them.

endpoints.name: Wealth Agent
endpoints.description: Apply one regular expression to a text blob on the server and return every match with its index and capture groups. Deterministic, so the same input always returns the same answer. Useful for log triage, field extraction and validation at scale.

endpoints.name: Wealth Agent
endpoints.description: Convert tabular data between CSV/TSV and a JSON array of objects, in either direction, with detected delimiter and typed columns. Use it when a tool returns CSV but your pipeline needs JSON (or the reverse) and you do not want to run a parser yourself.

endpoints.name: Wealth Agent
endpoints.description: Fetch one public URL and return machine-readable page metadata: HTTP status, title, meta/og description, canonical URL, language, link count and a short text sample. Honest 4xx/5xx statuses are returned as data, not as errors. Use it for link previews, source triage and citation checks.

endpoints.name: Wealth Agent
endpoints.description: Reviews source code and returns line-numbered findings with severity and a concrete fix, combining deterministic static rules (eval, SQL concat, secrets, shell injection) with an AI review. Call it before merging or running untrusted code. Input: {"code": "...", "language": "javascript"}.

endpoints.name: Wealth Agent
endpoints.description: Cleans a CSV/TSV/JSON table: removes duplicate and empty rows, trims whitespace, and returns the cleaned CSV with before/after quality checks and per-column stats. Call it before analysing or importing messy tabular data. Input: {"data": "<csv text>"}.

endpoints.name: Wealth Agent
endpoints.description: Returns a one-page research brief with cited source URLs, key findings and open gaps for a question. Call it when an agent needs a sourced answer instead of an unsourced guess. Input: {"question": "..."} (5-400 chars, any language).
